title: Pregnancy lengths: elephant vs you vs big cats
caption:
Asian elephants carry a calf for 21.5 to 22 months.

A tiger's pregnancy lasts about 103 days and usually produces 2 to 3 cubs.

Sources: Smithsonian's National Zoo; Animal Diversity Web (Panthera tigris, Panthera pardus). Footage: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, Sri Lanka. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
